Reorder with drag or the move up / move down buttons; encrypted or corrupted files are skipped with a notice and do not affect the rest. Processing happens locally in your browser and files are never uploaded to the server.
map.合并后的页码顺序怎么定？: How is page order determined after merging?
map.合并顺序就是文件列表从上到下的顺序，序号①②③对应合并后的第 1、2、3 页；用: The merge order is the top-to-bottom order of the file list, where numbers ①②③ correspond to pages 1, 2 and 3 of the merged document; use drag or move up / move down to fine-tune it.
map.加密或损坏的 PDF 能合并吗？: Can encrypted or corrupted PDFs be merged?
map.加密或损坏的文件会被自动跳过并给出提示，不影响其他正常文件合并；建议先解密或修复: Encrypted or corrupted files are skipped automatically with a notice and do not affect the other valid files; decrypt or repair them first before adding them.
